caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain and Choppy Seas Focus on St. Lucia
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing east to southeast winds near 10 kt, seas to 4.5 ft with an E dominant swell at a 6 s period, and 100% rain probability. I am advising operators in Roatan to expect higher winds up to 19 kt and to prepare for localized heavy rain and reduced visibility in port approaches.

mediterranean.headline: Palma Sees Modest Winds and 6 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Palma de Mallorca is experiencing southerly winds near 15 kt with seas to 6.0 ft and a dominant SSW swell period of 6 s, and a 38% rain probability. I expect minimal disruption to major port operations, and Barcelona will be calmer with winds around 10 kt, though brief showers and short-period seas could affect small craft.
